NONE: › a word that is repeated many times in order to produce the sound of people talking when the meaning of the word is not important
（演員模仿人聲嘈雜時用的詞）

example: Have you ever eaten rhubarb crumble?
你吃過大黃酥皮甜點心嗎？

演到人多嘈雜的場景時，我們都得站在台後模仿「嗡嗡」的嘈雜聲。
